description: "Use when: organizing documentation files or changing documentation structure."
applyTo: "**/*.md"
---

# Documentation maintainability rules

Keep documentation small enough to review and useful enough to revisit.

## One topic per page

Each page should have one main topic. Split a page when it starts covering multiple services, modules, or unrelated concepts.

## File size

Prefer pages that stay under about 1,500 words. Split a page before it becomes a long reference document with mixed concerns.

## Change scope

Keep each change focused. Do not mix repository structure changes, broad rewrites, and new study content in the same pass unless the user asks for it.

## No placeholders

Avoid empty placeholder pages. A starter page is acceptable when it explains the intended scope and includes concrete next steps.

## Navigation

When adding a new documentation area, update the nearest README or index page so readers can find it.
